name: lever neck right side flexion (plate loaded)
description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the right to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
